subject.title: feat(bedrock): enable prompt caching for Nova models

question: Should Bedrock Nova prompt caching use the new generic ProviderRuntimeModel supportsCacheRetention capability and become normal provider behavior, or should it remain Bedrock-local or explicitly opt-in?
rationale: The implementation adds an exported provider-model compatibility fact and changes upgrade behavior for existing Nova users; repository policy requires maintainer intent for the permanent plugin API and default.

options.title: Approve generic capability
options.body: Keep the provider-owned supportsCacheRetention fact, document and contract-test the public seam, and require live AWS proof before merge.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Enable Nova cache points only when users explicitly configure cacheRetention, avoiding an automatic behavior change for existing Nova setups.

options.title: Keep behavior local
options.body: Avoid expanding ProviderRuntimeModel and implement the eligibility decision entirely within the Bedrock-owned request path.

recommendation.title: Approve generic capability
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-owned supportsCacheRetention fact, document and contract-test the public seam, and require live AWS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the closest existing Bedrock cache-point implementation and tests.
